full_judgment: 3. The plaintiffs case, in brief, is that the suit land. originally belonged to Golam Nabi Sowdagar from whom she inherited her respective share in the suit property; that out of 4.28 acres of land of the disputed Khatian No. 1247 of 1977, Golam Nabi Sowdagar mortgaged 1.60 acres of land in favour of Abdus Salam and Nurul Islam by a registered mortgaged deed dated 7-5-1962, who were friends of him but possession was not delivered to them; that during old age of Go lam Nabi Sowdagar his son defendant-opposite party No.1, Abu Taher Masud was entrusted for management of the property who without redeeming 1.60 acres of land purchased the same in his own name; that the plaintiff and the defendants are the heirs of Golam Nabi Sowdagar and the plaintiffs being one of the daughter is entitled to have 0.21-1/4 acres of land by inheritance; that Golam Nabi Sowdagar died leaving behind two sons (defendant Nos. 1 and 2), five daughters (the plaintiff and the defendant Nos. 3-6) and one wife defendant No.7; and that defendant No.1 while refused to make partition of the suit land, the plaintiff filed the suit.
